name: Simify: Text-to-Simulation for STEM
tagline: Turns a STEM question into an interactive animated lesson generated on demand.
problem: Static diagrams make STEM concepts hard to grasp.
solution: Gemini designs a lesson and generates interactive UI and animation code, such as Riemann sums or damped springs, instead of computing the physics itself.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask about a sorting algorithm and step through it.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best .Tech Domain Name” among 176 submissions.
Lets the model design the lesson, not the maths.

lessons: Generated UI is the wow; keep the model off the calculation.
